descr.name: Inhibition Assay from US Patent US9211296B2: "Therapeutic compounds for blocking DNA synthesis of POX viruses"
description: A rapid plate DNA synthesis assay was performed using optimized conditions. Briefly, a 1.2:1 ratio of a 20-mer oligonucleotide primer (5′-GCGAATGAATGACCGCTGAC-3′, SEQ ID No. 1) and a 5′-end biotinylated 100-mer oligonucleotide template (5′-Biotin-AGCACTATTGACATTACAGAGTCGCCTTGGCTCTCTGGCTGTTCGTTGCGGGCTCCGCG TGCGTTGGCTTCGGTCGTCCCGTCAGCGGTCATTCATTGGC-3′) were annealed and loaded into a 96-well microtiter streptavidin-coated plate (Streptawell plates, Roche Applied Science, Indianapolis, Ind., USA) at 5 pmol/well. The wells were incubated at 37 C for 90 min, and washed with 100 L PBS. The reaction was conducted in low salt buffer (20 mM Tris-HCl pH 7.4, 3 mM MgCl2, 0.1 mM EDTA, 0.5 mM DTT, 2% glycerol, 40 ug/mL BSA, 5 uM dNTPs, 1 uM digoxigenin-11-2′-deoxyuridine-5′-triphosphate (DIG-dUTP, Roche Applied Science) with 1 μL vaccinia infected cell lysate or 1 uL of in vitro translated E9 DNA polymerase. The reaction plates were incubated at 37° C
comment: Compounds with any of Ki, IC50, Kd, or EC50 activity value <= 10uM are labeled as "Active".

If multiple measurements are available for a given compound, it is labeled as "Active" if any of the measurements meet the criterion. Activity values are checked in the order of Ki, IC50, Kd, and EC50. The first entry that meets the above activity threshold is used to determine "Standard Type", "Standard Relation", and "PubChem Standard Value". Otherwise, the first non-empty entry will be used to set those values.
